title: Volley It Home
style: world big band jazz, female lead vocal, brass and kora, 90 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
The volley is not a full swing.
It is a block. A redirect.
In every language, same technique.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Volley high, volley low
Compact swing, let it go
No backswing, just the block
Firm wrist, solid stock

[VERSE 2 - Cebuano transliteration]
Bolley taas, bolley ubos
Maigting nga paglabay, palargaa
Walang backswing, ang block lamang
Matibay nga pulso, malig-on nga basehan

[VERSE 3 - Amharic transliteration -- new verse]
Volley berta, volley tach
Mikur swing, yiqtal
Backswing yellem, block becha
Meqen kist, tiru

[CHORUS]
VOLLEY - BOLLEY - VOLEI - VOLEE
BLOCK AND REDIRECT - HOLD YOUR LINE
VOLLEY STRONG - EVERY SHOT
FIRM WRIST - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Uzbek -- new verse]
Volley yuqori, volley past
Ixcham siltash, qo'yib yuboring
Orqaga siltash yo'q, faqat blok
Mahkam bilak, mustahkam asos

[VERSE 5 - Breton transliteration]
Volley uhel, volley izel
Sving berr, lezel da vont
N'eus ket a ziskenn, nemet ar bloc
Ardivink tenn, diazez kaled

[VERSE 6 - Igbo transliteration]
Volley elu, volley ala
Ntapu pere mpe, hapuya
Enweghị backswing, naanị ngochi
Okpa nke ike, ntọala siri ike

[CHORUS]
VOLLEY - BOLLEY - VOLEI - VOLEE
BLOCK AND REDIRECT - HOLD YOUR LINE
VOLLEY STRONG - EVERY SHOT
FIRM WRIST - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Cebuano. Breton. Igbo.
No backswing. Ever.
Block. Redirect. Win.

[FINAL CHORUS]
VOLLEY - BOLLEY - VOLEI - VOLEE
BLOCK AND REDIRECT - HOLD YOUR LINE
VOLLEY STRONG - EVERY SHOT
FIRM WRIST - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE BLOCK
HOLD THE LINE - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Volley it home.
